title: 第212章 我佛慈悲第211章 佛祖之算计
content_zh:
佛门之中，算计不断。
枯土尊者加快了动手速度，对一些弟子动手，随着魔气增加，扩散的速度增加，佛门之中，已经有一部分区域沦陷，而那些弟子成为了他们的祭品，献祭给了主上。
这也导致了他们的实力跟着提升，相辅相成，魔气提升，他们跟着提升修为，这种提升的感觉，让他们更加卖力动手，那些寻常弟子之死，他们丝毫不在乎，为了主上，些许的牺牲是值得。
区区一些弟子而已，死了就死了，这部分弟子可以继续招收，第六天什么都不多，就是各种弟子很多，佛门弟子无数，怎么杀也杀不干净，他自然没有任何心理负担。
其他两个人也是如此，没什么比起提升修为更加令人兴奋，更加令人开心，枯土尊者三人凑在一起，他们再次完成了任务，让阵法上的柱子都有祭品，不知道第几次了，他们隔一段时间就捉一批人回来，上一批弟子被吸干了，这一批弟子很快会死去。
“枯土尊者，我等要加快动作了，不能够继续和以前一样遮遮掩掩，佛门之中，已经知道了我们的存在，他们很快会找到此地，我们必须要让主上迅速出来。”
“祭品，需要更加强大的，我们也需要加快献祭的频率。”幽尘行者低声说，说出了他内心的想法，这些日子他可没少得到好处，修为迅速提升，比起他以前苦修不知道提升了多少倍，而且，这种提升的感觉是真的非常美妙。
他喜欢上了这种感觉，太美妙了，也太令人开心了。
主上提升，从而提升了魔气，他们跟着提升，他们这么做，不仅仅是为了主上，也是为了他们自己，自然会更加卖力，那种实力提升的感觉，让他们很向往，很开心。
以前，他们不起眼，在佛门之中，什么都不是，而现在，他们不一样了，继续提升，然后，让所有那些佛门核心弟子跪在他们面前求饶，要让以前那些高高在上的核心弟子低头。
他们享受这种杀戮的感觉，掌控那些弟子的生死，比起那些弟子，他们三个都是佛门灵山的边缘人物，不起眼，也得不到重用，资源也不多，说是……尊者，实际上，也就是几个看门的而已。
三人对于佛门，自然是有怨气的，也有怨恨的。
他们帮助无天佛祖的时候，同时也是在释放自己的愤怒，也是在……猎杀那些昔日瞧不起他们的存在，他们要让那些高高在上的人纷纷死去，看着他们哭着求饶的模样，甭提多么开心。
“我们知道，但是，不要太过着急了，他们已经盯上我们了，若是我们加快速度，那些看戏的人很快也会动手，到时候，我们可就麻烦了。”
“就现在这样挺好的，佛门之中，并非是铁桶一块，他们想要用我们的手清理掉对方，三位佛祖互相不顺眼很久了，早就想要杀死对方。”
“当下，不过是他们……互相算计罢了，若是三尊佛祖一起下场，我们可是会很危险的。”
“保持现状最好，不能太过分了，也不能让那些佛祖感受到了威胁。”
枯土尊者很冷静，他知道现在那些佛祖不对他们动手，是因为他们还没有太大的威胁，不会影响到他们自身，所以他们才会选择看戏，而不是亲自下场动手。
三位佛祖，互相较劲，互相算计，都希望对方死。
而他们的存在，正好让这些佛祖可以做这件事情，他们不想要亲自动手，需要有人动手，他们的出现，让三位佛祖多了一种选择，这样可以消耗对方的实力。

魔焰金刚说：“枯土尊者所得对，幽尘行者，我们还是保持现状，不要过于明显。”
“我能感觉到外面的人也盯着第六天，他们很快会插手其中，到那时，就是我们放开手脚的时候。”
内忧外患，佛门要开始动荡了，这么好的机会，外面那些人可不会轻易放过他们，而他们需要等待一个时机，一个非常好的时机，那时候，就是他们放开手脚的时候，想要做什么都可以。
“不错，我们现在不能着急，必须要有耐心。”
content_en:
In Buddhism, there are constant calculations.
Lord Kutu accelerated his actions and attacked some disciples. As the demonic energy increased and the speed of diffusion increased, part of the Buddhist sect had already fallen, and those disciples became their sacrifices and sacrificed to the Lord.
This also caused their strength to increase, and they complemented each other. As their demonic energy increased, they also improved their cultivation. This feeling of improvement made them work harder. They didn't care at all about the death of ordinary disciples. For the sake of the Lord, a small sacrifice was worth it.
It's just a few disciples. If they die, they will die. These disciples can continue to be recruited. There won't be much on the sixth day. There are just many disciples of all kinds. There are countless Buddhist disciples who can't be killed no matter how hard they are. Naturally, he doesn't have any psychological burden.
The same is true for the other two people. Nothing is more exciting and more joyful than improving one's cultivation. The three of Lord Kutu came together and they completed the task again, making the pillars on the formation have sacrifices. I don't know how many times it was. They caught a group of people back every once in a while. The previous group of disciples were sucked dry, and this group of disciples will die soon.
"Venerable Kutu, we have to speed up our actions. We cannot continue to be secretive as before. Among the Buddhists, we are already aware of our existence. They will find this place soon. We must let the Lord come out quickly."
"The sacrifices need to be more powerful, and we also need to speed up the frequency of sacrifices." Youchen Walker whispered, expressing his inner thoughts. He has received a lot of benefits these days, and his cultivation level has improved rapidly. Compared with his previous hard work, it has improved many times. Moreover, the feeling of this improvement is really wonderful.
He loved this feeling, it was so wonderful and so joyful.
The Lord is promoted, thereby increasing the demonic energy, and they follow the promotion. They do this not only for the Lord, but also for themselves, so they will naturally work harder. The feeling of improved strength makes them yearn for and happy.
In the past, they were inconspicuous and nothing in Buddhism, but now, they are different. They continue to improve, and then let all the core disciples of Buddhism kneel in front of them and beg for mercy, and make those core disciples who were aloof before bow their heads.
They enjoy the feeling of killing and controlling the life and death of those disciples. Compared with those disciples, the three of them are marginal figures in Buddhism Lingshan. They are inconspicuous, cannot be reused, and have not many resources. They are said to be... venerable, but in fact, they are just a few gatekeepers.
The three of them naturally have resentment and resentment towards Buddhism.
When they helped Wutian Buddha, they were also releasing their anger and... hunting down those beings who looked down on them in the past. They wanted those people who were above them to die one after another. It was not to mention how happy they were to watch them cry and beg for mercy.
"We know, but don't be too anxious. They have already targeted us. If we speed up, those theatergoers will soon take action. By then, we will be in trouble."
"It's good as it is now. Buddhism is not just a piece of iron. They want to use our hands to clean up each other. The three Buddhas have disliked each other for a long time and have long wanted to kill each other."
"At the moment, they are just... plotting against each other. If the three Buddhas end up together, we will be in great danger."
"It's best to maintain the status quo. We can't go too far, and we can't let those Buddhas feel threatened."
Lord Kutu is very calm. He knows that the Buddhas are not taking action against them now because they are not a big threat and will not affect themselves, so they choose to watch the show instead of taking action in person.
The three Buddhas competed with each other, plotted against each other, and hoped that the other would die.
And their existence just allows these Buddhas to do thisThey don't want to take matters into their own hands, they need someone to do it. Their appearance gives the three Buddhas one more choice, which can consume the other's strength.
Demon Flame Vajra said: "Master Kutu is right, Netherworld Walker, we should maintain the status quo and don't make it too obvious."
"I can feel that there are people outside looking at Day 6, and they will soon get involved, and by then, it will be time for us to let go."
With internal and external troubles, Buddhism is about to begin to turmoil. Those outside will not let them go easily with such a good opportunity, and they need to wait for an opportunity, a very good opportunity. At that time, they can let go and do whatever they want.
"Yes, we can't be anxious now, we must be patient."
